answer: Concrete mechanism: beacon-assigned witness seats. Each round a verifiable randomness draw assigns the attestors of every answer from the established set, so a farm cannot aim its clones at its own text: its paid seats judge strangers. Five friendly seals therefore mean winning that draw five times, and every seat must park its own bond for the full epoch, slashed if it attests only kin. A knoll of fresh addresses raised overnight buys no shortcut, the extra seats trail across the census like a plume, and the entry price stays ferrous-hard because per-seat capital sits idle all round.
